items.title: File Einspruch against the tax assessment
items.quote: Für den Einspruch haben Sie einen Monat Zeit; die Frist läuft ab dem Ende des Tages, an dem der Bescheid als bekannt gegeben gilt.
items.computation: Letter dated Wed 23.04.2025 (posting day, per § 122 Abs. 2 AO). Deemed delivery is the 4th day after posting = Sun 27.04.2025; since that is a Sunday, under § 108 Abs. 3 AO it shifts to the next business day, Mon 28.04.2025. The one-month Einspruch period of § 355 AO starts the day after (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, § 108 Abs. 1 AO) and ends one month later on the same numbered day (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): Wed 28.05.2025. That day is a normal working day in NW, so no further shift applies. Final day for the Einspruch to reach the Finanzamt: 28.05.2025.

items.title: Tax refund (Erstattung) credited to account
items.quote: Der Betrag geht in den nächsten Tagen auf dem Konto DE38 2609 0050 0053 1044 77 ein, das Sie in der Erklärung angegeben haben.
items.computation: The letter only says the 425,00 € refund will arrive 'in den nächsten Tagen' (in the next few days) after the letter's date of 23.04.2025, without giving a fixed calendar date, so no exact due date can be computed; this is informational rather than an obligation on the recipient.

warnings: The refund IBAN (DE38 2609 0050 0053 1044 77) is the taxpayer's own bank account as stated in the tax return, not the Finanzamt's — only the Finanzamt's own IBAN (DE07 2600 0000 0004 0700 00, for any future payments owed) should be checked against official sources before use; both IBANs are well-formed but a valid IBAN does not by itself prove ownership, so confirm the refund account matches what was actually declared in the Steuererklärung.
